newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber ends mixed, distant months higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber ends mixed, distant months higher.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Monday with distant months supported by bullish sentiment carried over from Friday's rally, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen lower to 1.9 yen higher. Benchmark December was up 1.9 yen at 117.9 yen per kg.
"Light buying from individual investors supported distant months," a brokerage house trader said.

Local investors are closely watching the International Natural Rubber Organization's (INRO) possible intervention, traders said. "We're watching if and how actively INRO may intervene," another trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk
